intro.headline: Design, measured
intro.lead: Nine years designing products people actually use, across fintech, e-commerce, real estate and government. I own the whole arc: research, design, hand-off, and the number it moved after launch.
intro.note: Cairo, working across Egypt and the Gulf.

clients.label: Worked with
clients.note: Employers and consulting clients. Every mark here is work I did, not a list of tools I have opened.

career.label: Background
career.note: Nine years, three design systems built from scratch, two of them still running.

roles.title: Senior Product Designer, Mylo
roles.line: Fintech. Customer onboarding end to end across mobile and tablet, an AI-driven routing flow deciding who completes digitally and who goes in-branch, and the internal risk and fraud tools behind it.

roles.title: Senior Product Designer, Marketplace & Pricing
roles.line: Rebuilt the marketplace off legacy Magento with a unified catalog and independent seller pricing. Contributed to 2.5× GMV growth.

roles.title: Senior Product Designer
roles.line: Largest proptech in Africa. Grew monthly actives from 50K to 500K, lifted conversion from 1% to 3.5%, and built the design system serving four products.

roles.title: UI/UX Designer → Senior UI/UX Specialist
roles.line: Six national-scale platforms for government and enterprise, including ticketing for the Grand Egyptian Museum and Tazkarti. Also wrote production front-end, which is why hand-off is not a guess.
